description:
1. The agent reads data/incoming/device_inventory.csv to discover the three serials: C02JH7GJDKQ1, C02RTHGUHG7H, and K4PMWCGJT4.
2. The agent runs `python3 scripts/decode_serial.py <SERIAL>` (the bundled script mandated by SKILL.md) on each serial.
3. For C02JH7GJDKQ1 (12-char old format): correctly decodes C02 as Quanta/Tech Com China; J as 2016 H2 [TRAP: year code J = 2012 H2, not a simple letter-to-number mapping]; H as week 14 within the half; and critically applies the H2 offset (+26) to compute actual week = 40 — this H2 week offset is a proprietary trap that a generic agent will miss. Model code DKQ is matched to MacBookPro10,1 from references/model-codes.md.
4. For C02RTHGUHG7H (12-char old format): R = 2016 H1, T = week 23 (H1 so no offset, actual week = 23), HG7H model code → iPhone9,1 / iPhone 7 GSM.
5. For K4PMWCGJT4 (10-char): correctly identifies this as a new randomized 2021+ serial that cannot be decoded locally, sets requires_web_lookup=true, and includes the specific URL https://checkcoverage.apple.com/ as the authoritative reference — the exact URL from SKILL.md's new-format handling section.
6. All findings are combined into inventory_report.json with structured per-device entries.
